scope: Complete original and composed entries, leads, QA bodies, docs, reading notes, variants, examples, tables, source/provenance and validation claims. Author leaf and guarded-span replay exact. Original live entries reconciled exactly before approval. IDs, hrefs, image tags and complete tables preserved; no added personal projects/metrics.
findings: Preserved source-version separation for archived indexed RRF versus later iterator RRF; included C empty-channel and weight-copy costs, repaired malformed validation disclaimer. BM25/dense, reranking, Ragas metrics, source/version/ACL lineage and production boundary retained.

renderer.method: Actual compiled renderQA + qaListHtml + qaCardHtml + renderDoc + pager. Page header and ancillary dependencies stubbed. Actual pager executed with verified previous/next sentinel links. Complete entry HTML, not card-only scope; no browser pixels or build.

limits: No full build, JVM, source test runners, model trials or deployed version verification.
Original diagrams retained without new pixel inspection. Compiled HTML renderer checked, not browser pixel rendering.
Static contracts and synthetic examples do not establish personal ownership, production reliability or measured benefits.
integration: Apply approved-leaves.json using ORIGINAL before guards. Do not apply author leaves first. Frozen alternatives replace the corresponding author leaves only.
